Full-trail ticket EUR10.50/person 13+ (kids 12 and under free but must be registered); the Arieiro-Pedra Rija segment stayed two-way with a EUR4.50 partial ticket during phased reopening — confirm which ticket the out-and-back needs on SIMplifica when booking. spots.climate: At 6,000 ft: June highs only 50-59 F and windy — pack fleece and windbreakers. Mornings are usually clear and cloud builds by mid-morning: this is the cloud lottery, and it is exactly why the plan holds five Madeira nights. Check the Arieiro webcam the same morning before committing.
spots.saveHtml: Save The family version is the out-and-back from Arieiro to the Ninho da Manta and Pedra Rija balconies (~1.2-2 km each way) — the postcard "Stairway to Heaven" staircase views without the full traverse, which is too strenuous for the 8-year-old.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge If you skip the rental car, a sunrise shuttle runs about EUR35-40/person (EUR140-160 family) door-to-door — otherwise drive up 60+ minutes before sunrise, because the summit lot fills and police close the road when it overflows.

spots.saveHtml: Save Turn around at the Ponta do Furado viewpoint if the 8-year-old fades — the striated-cliff money views come in the first half of the trail.

html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);
 font:16px/1.55 "Inter",ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:"Fraunces","Georgia",serif;letter-spacing:-.01em}
a{color:var(--c1)}
.eyebrow{margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--c2);font-size:.72rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase}
/* HERO */
header{position:relative;min-height:90vh;display:grid;align-items:end;padding:40px clamp(20px,5vw,80px) 54px;color:#fff;overflow:hidden}
header::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(10,20,24,.12),rgba(10,18,22,.34) 45%,rgba(8,14,18,.88)),url("../../assets/img/madeira-sicily/img-2ad53044dda3.jpg") center 40% / cover;transform:scale(1.03);z-index:-1}
.hero-inner{max-width:1100px}
header .kicker{display:inline-flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin:0 0 20px;padding:7px 15px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4);border-radius:999px;font-size:.74rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;backdrop-filter:blur(6px);background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
h1{margin:0 0 18px;font-size:clamp(2.9rem,9vw,7rem);line-height:.9;font-weight:600;text-shadow:0 2px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
header .lead{max-width:640px;margin:0 0 26px;font-size:clamp(1.05rem,2.1vw,1.3rem);color:rgba(255,255,255,.94);line-height:1.5}
.hero-meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:26px}
.hero-meta div{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.hero-meta b{font-family:"Fraunces",serif;font-size:1.5rem;line-height:1}
.hero-meta span{font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);margin-top:4px}
/* NAV */
section[id],article[id]{scroll-margin-top:84px}
.site-nav{z-index:500;--nav-bg:#17130f;--nav-panel:#211c16;--nav-panel-2:#2a231b;--nav-line:rgba(246,241,231,.16);--nav-text:#f6f1e7;--nav-muted:rgba(246,241,231,.62);--nav-active:#5f9aa3;--nav-active-ink:#061517;--nav-shadow:0 18px 42px rgba(12,10,8,.28)}
.site-nav summary{list-style:none}
.site-nav summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.site-nav a{color:var(--nav-text);font-weight:800;text-decoration:none;line-height:1.2;transition:background .15s,color .15s,border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s}
.site-nav a.active{background:var(--nav-active);color:var(--nav-active-ink);border-color:var(--nav-active);box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(95,154,163,.22)}
@media(min-width:960px){
  body{padding-left:clamp(210px,17vw,248px)}
  section[id],article[id]{scroll-margin-top:24px}
  .site-nav{position:fixed;inset:0 auto 0 0;width:clamp(210px,17vw,248px);display:block;padding:18px 14px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(33,28,22,.98),rgba(18,15,12,.97));border-right:1px solid var(--nav-line);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);box-shadow:14px 0 42px rgba(12,10,8,.26);overflow:hidden;color:var(--nav-text)}
  .site-nav-menu{height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:0;overflow:hidden}
  .site-nav summary{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin:0 0 12px;padding:10px 10px 13px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--nav-line);color:var(--nav-muted);font-size:.7rem;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:default}
  .site-nav summary::after{content:"";width:26px;height:2px;background:var(--nav-line)}
  .site-nav-links{flex:1 1 auto;display:grid;align-content:start;gap:6px;overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;min-height:0;max-height:calc(100vh - 92px);padding:2px 2px 16px;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:rgba(246,241,231,.26) transparent}
  .site-nav a{display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:36px;padding:8px 10px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:8px;background:transparent;font-size:.82rem}
  .site-nav a:hover{background:rgba(246,241,231,.1);color:#fff;border-color:var(--nav-line)}
  .site-nav a.nav-home{margin-bottom:6px;background:rgba(42,83,89,.42);color:var(--nav-active);border-color:rgba(95,154,163,.48)}
}
@media(max-width:959px){
  .site-nav{position:sticky;top:0;padding:10px clamp(14px,4vw,22px);background:rgba(23,19,15,.96);border-bottom:1px solid var(--nav-line);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(12,10,8,.18)}
  .site-nav-menu{max-width:1320px;margin:0 auto}
  .site-nav summary{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;min-height:42px;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--nav-line);border-radius:10px;background:var(--nav-panel);box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(12,10,8,.22);color:var(--nav-text);font-size:.84rem;font-weight:900;cursor:pointer}
  .site-nav summary::after{content:"+";display:grid;place-items:center;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--nav-active);color:var(--nav-active-ink);font-size:1rem;line-height:1}
  .site-nav-menu[open] summary{border-color:rgba(95,154,163,.55)}
  .site-nav-menu[open] summary::after{content:"-"}
  .site-nav-links{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(145px,1fr));gap:7px;margin-top:8px;max-height:min(70vh,480px);overflow:auto;padding:8px;border:1px solid var(--nav-line);border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--nav-panel),var(--nav-bg));box-shadow:0 18px 42px rgba(12,10,8,.34)}
  .site-nav a{display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:42px;padding:9px 10px;border:1px solid var(--nav-line);border-radius:8px;background:rgba(246,241,231,.06);font-size:.82rem}
  .site-nav a.nav-home,.site-nav a:hover{background:var(--nav-active);color:var(--nav-active-ink);border-color:var(--nav-active)}
}
main{max-width:1320px;margin:0 auto;padding:56px clamp(18px,5vw,60px) 40px}
.section-label{text-align:center;margin:0 auto 28px;max-width:min(1320px,100%)}
.section-label h2{margin:.08em 0 .16em;font-size:clamp(1.75rem,3.1vw,2.55rem);line-height:.92;font-weight:600;text-wrap:balance}
.section-label p{max-width:960px;margin:0 auto;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.38}
.divider{margin:78px 0 40px}
/* OVERVIEW */
.overview{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:18px;margin-bottom:26px}
.ocard{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:22px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.ocard .eyebrow{color:var(--c1)}
.ocard h4{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:600}
.ocard p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:.92rem}
/* TRIP MAP */
.hc-grid{display:block;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);overflow:hidden}
.hc{display:grid;grid-template-columns:132px minmax(190px,285px) minmax(0,1fr);gap:16px;align-items:start;margin:0;padding:18px 22px;border:0;border-left:5px solid var(--muted);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:0;background:transparent;box-shadow:none}
.hc:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.hc.actnow{border-left-color:#c0392b}
.hc.watch{border-left-color:var(--gold)}
.hc.good{border-left-color:var(--c3)}
.hc-tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:max-content;max-width:100%;font-size:.66rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:999px;margin:1px 0 0;color:#fff;text-align:center;white-space:nowrap}
.hc.actnow .hc-tag{background:#c0392b}
.hc.watch .hc-tag{background:var(--gold)}
.hc.good .hc-tag{background:var(--c3)}
.hc h4{margin:0;font-size:1.08rem;font-weight:600;line-height:1.16}
.hc p{margin:0;font-size:.92rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.48}
.hc p b{color:var(--ink)}
@media(max-width:860px){.hc{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:8px;padding:16px 18px}.hc-tag{margin:0}.hc h4{font-size:1.05rem}}

/* TRAVEL TIPS */
.tips-order{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:18px 20px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);margin-bottom:22px}
.tips-order p.mini-h{margin:0 0 12px}
.tips-order ol{margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;counter-reset:step}
.tips-order li{counter-increment:step;position:relative;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:7px 14px 7px 30px;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600}
.tips-order li::before{content:counter(step);position:absolute;left:6px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c1);color:#fff;font-size:.68rem;font-weight:800;display:grid;place-items:center}
.tips-order li span{color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.tips-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(340px,1fr));gap:18px}
.tipcard{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:20px 22px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);border-top:4px solid var(--c1)}
.tipcard.t2{border-top-color:var(--c2)}.tipcard.t3{border-top-color:var(--gold)}.tipcard.t4{border-top-color:var(--c3)}
.tipcard h4{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:600}
.tipcard .sub{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:.74rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.tipcard ul{margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none;display:grid;gap:11px}
.tipcard li{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5;padding-left:16px;position:relative}
.tipcard li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:8px;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold)}
.tipcard li b{color:var(--ink)}
.tipcard li.flag::before{background:#c0392b;width:8px;height:8px;top:7px}
.tipcard li.flag b{color:#b5361f}

.daycost{display:inline-block;margin:8px 0 0;font-size:.76rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--c2);background:rgba(194,90,58,.1);border:1px solid rgba(194,90,58,.28);border-radius:999px;padding:3px 11px}
.budget-tbl.grand tr.total td{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:800}
.rate-note{margin:12px 2px 0;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5}

.kv.climate{margin-top:10px;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px dashed var(--line)}
.kv.climate span{color:var(--c1)}

/* TIMING COMPARE */
.timing-compare{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:18px;margin-bottom:22px}
.tcard{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:20px 22px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);border-top:4px solid var(--muted)}
.tcard.now{border-top-color:var(--c1)}
.tcard.later{border-top-color:var(--c2)}
.tcard.best{border-top-color:var(--c3)}
.tcard.best .tlabel{background:var(--c3)}
.tcard .tlabel{display:inline-block;font-size:.7rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:999px;margin-bottom:10px;color:#fff}
.tcard.now .tlabel{background:var(--c1)}
.tcard.later .tlabel{background:var(--c2)}
.tcard h4{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:600}
.tcard .trow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;padding:7px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.88rem}
.tcard .trow:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.tcard .trow span{color:var(--muted)}
.tcard .trow strong{text-align:right}
.tcard .trow strong.bad{color:#b5361f}
.listcard.pro-list{border-top:4px solid var(--c3)}
.listcard.con-list{border-top:4px solid #c0392b}
.listcard.pro-list li::before{content:"✓";position:static;width:auto;height:auto;border-radius:0;background:none;color:var(--c3);font-weight:800;margin-right:6px}
.listcard.con-list li::before{content:"✗";position:static;width:auto;height:auto;border-radius:0;background:none;color:#c0392b;font-weight:800;margin-right:6px}
.listcard.pro-list li,.listcard.con-list li{padding-left:0;display:flex;gap:2px}
.listcard.pro-list li>span,.listcard.con-list li>span{flex:1}
.verdict-box{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:5px solid var(--ink);border-radius:14px;padding:20px 22px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);margin-top:20px}
.verdict-box h4{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:800}
.verdict-box p{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:.92rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.55}
.verdict-box p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.verdict-box .aside{font-size:.82rem;font-style:italic;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);padding-top:10px;margin-top:12px}

.tripmap-wrap{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:14px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.mapbtns{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px}
.mapbtns button{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-weight:700;font-size:.82rem;padding:7px 14px;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s}
.mapbtns button:hover{background:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.mapbtns button .sw{display:inline-block;width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;margin-right:6px;vertical-align:middle}
#tripmap{height:460px;border-radius:14px;z-index:1}
.leaflet-popup-content{font:14px/1.4 "Inter",sans-serif}
.leaflet-popup-content b{font-family:"Fraunces",serif}
.pin{width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;border:2.5px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
/* BASES */
.bases{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:20px}
.base{position:relative;background:var(--card);border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.base .band{height:6px}
.base.b1 .band{background:var(--c1)}.base.b2 .band{background:var(--c2)}.base.b3 .band{background:var(--c3)}
.base .bimg{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/10;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.base .bbody{padding:18px 20px 22px}
.base .nights{display:inline-block;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:999px;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#fff;margin-bottom:10px}
.base.b1 .nights{background:var(--c1)}.base.b2 .nights{background:var(--c2)}.base.b3 .nights{background:var(--c3)}
.base h4{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:1.55rem;font-weight:600}
.base .dates{margin:0 0 10px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.85rem;font-weight:600}
.base p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem}
.base .book{margin:12px 0 0;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.82rem;color:var(--ink)}
.base .book b{color:var(--c2)}
/* PLAN GRID */
.plan-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px}
.pcard{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:22px 24px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.pcard h4{margin:0 0 14px;font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:600;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.pcard h4 .dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold)}
.prow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.9rem}
.prow:last-of-type{border-bottom:0}
.prow span{color:var(--muted)}.prow strong{text-align:right}
.pcard .tip{margin:12px 0 0;padding:10px 12px;background:rgba(217,164,65,.12);border-radius:10px;font-size:.82rem;color:#8a6a1e}
/* DAYS */
.days{display:grid;gap:26px}
.day{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow);border-left:6px solid var(--c1)}
.day.c1{border-left-color:var(--c1)}.day.c2{border-left-color:var(--c2)}.day.c3{border-left-color:var(--c3)}.day.c0{border-left-color:var(--muted)}
.day-head{display:flex;gap:18px;align-items:center;padding:20px 24px 6px}
.day-badge{flex:0 0 auto;width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:14px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-family:"Fraunces",serif;font-weight:600;font-size:1.15rem;color:#fff;line-height:1;text-align:center}
.day.c1 .day-badge{background:var(--c1)}.day.c2 .day-badge{background:var(--c2)}.day.c3 .day-badge{background:var(--c3)}.day.c0 .day-badge{background:var(--muted)}
.day-title h3{margin:2px 0 4px;font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:600;line-height:1.05}
.day-title .feel{margin:0;color:var(--c2);font-size:.82rem;font-weight:700}
.logistics{padding:4px 24px 12px}
.facts{display:grid;margin:6px 0 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden}
.facts div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:64px 1fr;gap:12px;padding:9px 13px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.86rem}
.facts div:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.facts span{color:var(--muted);font-size:.68rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;padding-top:2px}
.facts strong{font-weight:600}
.note{margin:0;color:var(--ink);font-size:.94rem;line-height:1.55}
/* SPOTS */
.spots-wrap{display:grid;gap:20px;padding:6px 24px 24px}
.travel-note{padding:40px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:14px;font-weight:600}
.spot{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper)}
.spot-head{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:14px 16px}
.spot-name{margin:0;font-size:1.22rem;font-weight:600}
.explore{display:flex;gap:6px;flex:0 1 auto;min-width:0;max-width:100%;overflow-x:auto;overscroll-behavior-x:contain;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;scrollbar-width:none}
.explore::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.explore a{font-size:.7rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.02em;text-decoration:none;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:999px;color:#fff;transition:.15s;white-space:nowrap}
.explore a:hover{filter:brightness(1.08);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.explore .xg{background:#4285F4}
.explore .xi{background:linear-gradient(45deg,#f09433,#dc2743 55%,#bc1888)}
.explore .xf{background:#0063dc}
/* CAROUSEL */
.carousel{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#e7e1d4}
.track{display:flex;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;scroll-behavior:smooth;scrollbar-width:none}
.track::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.track figure{margin:0;flex:0 0 100%;scroll-snap-align:center;position:relative}
.track img{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/2;object-fit:cover;background:#e7e1d4}
.track figcaption{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;padding:26px 14px 10px;color:#fff;font-size:.74rem;line-height:1.3;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,rgba(0,0,0,.68))}
.track figcaption strong{display:block;font-weight:700}
.track figcaption span{color:rgba(255,255,255,.82);font-size:.66rem}
.nav{position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:rgba(255,255,255,.86);color:var(--ink);font-size:1.4rem;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.25);transition:.15s;z-index:2}
.nav:hover{background:#fff;transform:translateY(-50%) scale(1.08)}
.nav.prev{left:12px}.nav.next{right:12px}
.counter{position:absolute;top:12px;right:12px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);color:#fff;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:999px;z-index:2}
.dots{position:absolute;bottom:10px;left:0;right:0;display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:6px;z-index:2;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:0 40px}
.dots .dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:rgba(255,255,255,.5);cursor:pointer;padding:0;transition:.15s}
.dots .dot.on{background:#fff;width:20px;border-radius:999px}
/* SPOT GRID */
.spot-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.15fr) minmax(0,.85fr);gap:18px;padding:16px}
.mini-h{margin:0 0 6px;font-weight:800;font-size:.76rem;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.kv{margin-bottom:12px}
.kv span{font-weight:800;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--ink)}
.kv p{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:.9rem;color:var(--muted)}
.callout{border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:.86rem;margin-bottom:10px;line-height:1.45}
.callout b{font-weight:800}
.callout.save{background:rgba(63,125,78,.1);border-left:3px solid var(--save)}
.callout.save b{color:var(--save)}
.callout.splurge{background:rgba(217,164,65,.14);border-left:3px solid var(--splurge)}
.callout.splurge b{color:var(--splurge)}

    <div class="section-label">
      <p class="eyebrow">Where We Are Staying</p>
      <h2>Four bases, two trip modes</h2>
      <p>Each base has one job: Madeira carries the epic-scenery hiking week, Lisbon absorbs FNC wind risk, Cefalù handles north-coast swimming plus Palermo, and the Taormina coast finishes with Etna and the Catania exit.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="bases">
      <div class="base b1"><div class="band"></div>
        <img class="bimg" src="../../assets/img/madeira-sicily/img-e44aabbf5284.jpg" alt="Funchal (Lido / hotel zone)">
        <div class="bbody">
          <span class="nights">5 nights · Jun 9-13</span>
          <h4>Funchal (Lido / hotel zone)</h4><p class="dates">Madeira hiking base</p>
          <p>One unpacked base for the whole island: Madeira is small enough that Arieiro, Rabaçal, Porto Moniz, and São Lourenço are all 30-70 minute drives. Five nights is deliberate — summit weather is a lottery, and a long base means the ridge day can float to whichever morning is clear.</p>
          <p class="book"><b>Book:</b> Family aparthotel or 2BR apartment with parking in the Lido/hotel zone. Current 2026 proxy band: roughly EUR130-220/night (~$140-240). Warning: <b>AC is not standard in Madeira apartments</b> — filter for it explicitly. Examples: Hotel Duas Torres (aparthotel, pool, free parking), Pestana Village Garden.</p>
        </div>
      </div><div class="base b2"><div class="band"></div>
        <img class="bimg" src="../../assets/img/madeira-sicily/img-e3fb1af5cd71.jpg" alt="Lisbon airport zone">
        <div class="bbody">
          <span class="nights">1 night · Jun 14</span>
          <h4>Lisbon airport zone</h4><p class="dates">FNC wind insurance + bonus evening</p>
          <p>Not a base — a bonus mainland evening that exists because Funchal's airport has real wind-cancellation risk and the Palermo flight is twice-weekly. Land ~evening, sleep 200 m from the terminal, and spend the evening on the Parque das Nações waterfront ten minutes away (Oceanarium if the kids have energy).</p>
          <p class="book"><b>Book:</b> Meliá Lisboa Aeroporto (true family rooms, ~EUR180-280 estimated) or Star Inn Lisbon (budget, ~EUR110-170). Only trade this for a Cascais evening if the 2027 LIS-PMO rotation is the afternoon (15:10-style) departure.</p>
        </div>
      </div><div class="base b3"><div class="band"></div>
        <img class="bimg" src="../../assets/img/madeira-sicily/img-ca298a5ef143.jpg" alt="Cefalù">
        <div class="bbody">
          <span class="nights">3 nights · Jun 15-17</span>
          <h4>Cefalù</h4><p class="dates">North Sicily beach + Palermo access</p>
          <p>Cefalù earns the first Sicily base because it is softer for families than sleeping in Palermo: sandy beach, La Rocca views, walkable dinners, and a direct train/drive into Palermo when you want the city hit. This is where the trip's real warm-water swimming starts.</p>
          <p class="book"><b>Book:</b> Family apartment with AC, washer, and either parking or walkable station access. Current 2026 proxy bands: roughly $180-330/night for practical family stays; beachfront/pool properties run higher.</p>
        </div>
      </div><div class="base b4"><div class="band"></div>
        <img class="bimg" src="../../assets/img/madeira-sicily/img-9c38e7bec4f4.jpg" alt="Giardini-Naxos / Mazzarò / Letojanni">
        <div class="bbody">
          <span class="nights">3 nights · Jun 18-20</span>
          <h4>Giardini-Naxos / Mazzarò / Letojanni</h4><p class="dates">Taormina, Isola Bella, Etna, CTA exit</p>
          <p>Do not pay old-town Taormina prices unless a rare deal appears. The better family move is a beach-side or lower-slope base with parking, then visit Taormina by cable car/taxi and use the last morning for Catania airport.</p>
          <p class="book"><b>Book:</b> AC, parking, and pool/beach access matter more than a postcard balcony. Current 2026 proxy data shows basic Taormina hotels from ~$150-210/night, while beach/view/family properties can jump past $350-600/night.</p>

Best fit

Madeira fixes the scenery-and-hiking brief; Sicily still owns the swimming

The family wants the Portugal leg to be epic scenery and hiking, not swimming — and Madeira is exactly that: the Arieiro-Ruivo ridge above a cloud sea, 25 Fontes, Fanal fog forest, São Lourenço cliffs. Five nights matter because the summit is a cloud lottery — multiple mornings means multiple shots at a clear ridge. June sea in Sicily is roughly 72-75 F; Madeira's ~68 F stays a bonus dip, not the main event.

Flight gate

Four flight legs — the cap works only if airfare behaves

This route flies PIT-FNC, FNC-LIS, LIS-PMO, and CTA-PIT. Current June proxy data puts the family total around $5.6k-$6.4k; treat $6.2k as the hard booking gate. Watch for United's summer 2027 EWR-FNC nonstop announcement (~late 2026) — a PIT-EWR-FNC one-ticket on its Tue/Thu/Sat red-eye pattern is the cleanest and often cheapest way in.

Route hinge — season gate

The LIS-PMO nonstop may not even fly in June — hard pre-book check

This nonstop is the whole reason to pick Sicily over Crete (Crete has no Lisbon nonstop, ever — always 1 stop via Athens, a ~7-8 hr travel day). But easyJet is the only carrier flying LIS-PMO nonstop, twice weekly, and 2026 schedules show it running July-September only — the launch was June 2025, but current listings do not confirm a June rotation. If 2027 follows the July-start pattern, there is no June nonstop and this branch's core advantage disappears for the Jun 8-21 window. Booking gate (~Oct-Dec 2026, when easyJet loads S27): (1) June Tue/Fri nonstop present -> book LIS-PMO immediately, lock Sicily; (2) nonstop is July-only -> either shift the trip into July, or fall back to Madeira+Crete; (3) take June with a same-day one-stop via Rome FCO (~+$100-250 pp) — but then the travel day is no shorter than Crete's and Crete's denser routing wins. Do not lock nonrefundable Sicily lodging until the June nonstop is confirmed on the calendar.

FNC wind risk

The Lisbon buffer night is mandatory insurance, not a luxury

Funchal airport is one of Europe's most wind-disrupted: roughly 3% of flights cancelled in 2024, with multi-day events (22 cancellations in one June 2026 wind day, 80+ diversions in one 2024 event). That is why this plan flies FNC-LIS on Monday Jun 14 and sleeps in Lisbon before Tuesday's Palermo flight — never chain FNC -> LIS -> PMO on the same day.

Honest tradeoff

This branch drops Ortigia, Noto, and Vendicari — and costs more

Versus the mainland Portugal-Sicily version: the southeast of Sicily is gone entirely (no Ortigia, no Noto, no Vendicari), airfare adds roughly +$400-$1,000 for the FNC legs and buffer night, FNC wind risk enters the plan, and it still has 4 lodging stops. What you buy with all that: a genuinely world-class hiking-and-scenery week that mainland Portugal cannot match.

  • Keep the car instead of Arieiro transfers. One sunrise shuttle for 4 costs EUR140-160 — roughly 2-3 full days of Madeira rental.
  • Skip an Etna summit buy-up unless visibility is clear. Free Silvestri craters protect several hundred dollars.
  • Stay below Taormina. Giardini-Naxos/Letojanni/Mazzarò preserve the east-coast finish without old-town hotel and parking pain.

Worth the splurge

  • Arieiro at sunrise. The cost is an alarm clock and EUR4.50 parking — the payoff is the single best view of the entire trip, above a sea of clouds.
  • Monte toboggan baskets. EUR80 cash for two baskets of shrieking children is the best-value memory purchase on Madeira.
  • Sea View rooftop lunch at Porto Moniz. Burgers over exploding surf, ~EUR60-80 for four.
  • One Sicily beach-club day. Shade, bathrooms, and food can rescue the 8-year-old on a hot afternoon.
  • Ancient Theatre at golden hour + Isola Bella boat. EUR42 of tickets plus $120-250 of boat is the east-coast finale done right.

Travel Tips

The stuff nobody tells you

Practical notes based on July 2026 research, official 2026 Madeira fees, and current 2026 ticket/transport proxies.

Book in roughly this order

  1. Airfare + the LIS-PMO Tuesday rotation · the moment easyJet's summer 2027 schedule loads (~Oct-Dec 2026)
  2. United EWR-FNC 2027 confirmation · watch for the seasonal announcement in late 2026
  3. Refundable apartments (Funchal + both Sicily bases) · 9-12 months out
  4. Rental cars — Madeira automatic especially · right after flights; automatics sell out months ahead
  5. SIMplifica trail slots · PR1, PR6, PR8 · days-to-weeks ahead; the 7:00-8:30 Arieiro slots go first
  6. Etna guide / Isola Bella boat · on the ground, after the weather window is clear
  7. Restaurant reservations in Taormina · 1-3 weeks ahead

  • Booking Rules

    What can break the plan

    • The Tuesday LIS-PMO is the hinge. It exists today (2x weekly, easyJet), but it's a new seasonal route — confirm the 2027 rotation before locking nonrefundable Sicily lodging.
    • Never chain FNC -> LIS -> PMO same-day. Funchal wind cancels ~3% of flights and events run multi-day; the Lisbon night is structural.
    • Keep the airfare gate hard. Four legs at $6.2k family is the preference-fit ceiling; above it, trim before booking.
    • Hold refundable lodging first. Funchal June is the island's most-booked month, and Sicily family apartments with AC and parking go early.

  • Madeira Mountain Rules

    How to win the cloud lottery

    • SIMplifica is mandatory. PR1/PR6/PR8 all need pre-booked 30-minute entry slots; no walk-ups, fines up to EUR250. Kids 12 and under are free but must be registered.
    • Let the ridge day float. Five nights exist so the Arieiro morning can move to whichever day the webcam shows a clear summit.
    • Sunrise parking is chaos. Arrive 60+ minutes early or the police close the road and you walk 30 minutes uphill.
    • Pack for 50 F in June. The summit runs 50-59 F with wind while Funchal sits at 75 F — fleece and windbreakers ride in the daypack all week.

  • Driving Two Islands

    Different rules each

    • Madeira: steep, tunneled, signposted. ~150 tunnels and serious grades; follow road signs near villages, not GPS shortcuts, and descend in low gear.
    • Sicily: one car, west to east. Pick up at PMO, drop at CTA, never drive back west.
    • ZTLs matter in Sicily. Cefalù and Taormina punish casual driving; lodging must spell out parking in writing.

  • Picky Eaters

    Plain food at every base

    • Funchal. Lido-promenade and old-town pizzerias (Il Basilico, Xaramba) make dinner low-friction; groceries handle breakfast.
    • West + east Madeira. Porto Moniz has burgers over the pools; Machico has a 4.7-star Neapolitan pizzeria after São Lourenço.
    • Lisbon + Sicily. Parque das Nações has a pizzeria with a kids' area; in Sicily choose pizzerias and beach towns for kids, seafood rooms for adult lunches.

  • Heat + Water

    The real trip rhythm

    • Madeira is the cool act. 68 F sea and 50-59 F summits — swimming there is a bonus (Porto Moniz, Machico), not the mission.
    • Sicily is the warm act. 72-75 F sea from Jun 15 on; that's why the trim fell on Ortigia/Noto, not on beach days.
    • Hike early, swim after. São Lourenço and Etna are exposed by 11 AM; every hot morning ends at water.
    • Protect the final swim day. Do not turn Jun 20 into another logistics day.

What People Are Saying

Insider field notes

Crowd-sourced from Reddit, TripAdvisor, AllTrails, and local-run blogs (July 2026) — the off-the-beaten-path stuff guidebooks skip. Reconfirm permits, tides, and prices closer to travel.

  • Madeira above the clouds

    The ridge, timed right

    • The Stairway photo is better in the afternoon. Everyone crowds Arieiro for a cold, hazy sunrise; the local secret is 1–2 hrs before sunset for soft light and thin crowds. If you do chase the cloud-inversion sunrise, be parked by ~6:45am.
    • Real headlamps, not phone lights. The 25 Fontes / Rabaçal route and the PR1 ridge run through long pitch-black tunnels; every family member needs a dedicated light (phones die fast in there).
    • Kid-sized levada. If the ridge is too much, PR11 Levada dos Balcões (Ribeiro Frio) is short, flat, wide, and ends at a mountain lookout — "piece of cake for kids."

  • Madeira: pools, poncha, landings

    Coast-side reality checks

    • Check the Porto Moniz webcam before driving out. Swell slams the lava pools without warning; the sea is calmest in the morning and best at higher tide. Water shoes are essential on the razor rock — the free "Piscinas do Aquário" nearby is where locals swim.
    • Expect a dramatic FNC landing. Funchal has strict crosswind limits and terrain-induced shear; landings are statistically safe but feel bumpy, and ~2% divert. Brief nervous flyers ahead of time.
    • Drink poncha where locals do. Rei da Poncha in Funchal or Bar Filhos do Mar in Câmara de Lobos — ask for the traditional fisherman's poncha, and go slow; it's stronger than it tastes.

  • Etna with kids, done right

    Don't force the summit

    • Etna Sud + the lower Silvestri craters is plenty. Cable car from Rifugio Sapienza, then the walkable ~2000m craters — moonscape without altitude sickness. Guides are legally required above 2500m; a 4x4 minibus saves little legs.
    • Add a lava tube. A guided volcanic cave (helmet + torch) thrills kids; the quieter Etna Nord side is less mobbed than Sud — confirm the age minimum with the operator.
    • Early June beats peak summer. Etna can see 50,000 visitors a day in high season; go early, and the lava fields are snow-free and visible.

  • Sicily's crowd clock & ZTL

    Timing and the mailed fine

    • Cefalù by 8am, western end of the beach. Beats ~80% of the day-trippers who cluster east near the cathedral; the town itself goes dead and shuttered 2–6pm.
    • In Taormina, don't drive — ride. The cable car (€6) and €1.90 buses beat the town's brutal parking (Mazzarò has ~180 spaces); streets are single-lane ZTL traps.
    • ZTL fines arrive months later. A daily €2.50 pass from any Tabacchi shop (or having your old-town hotel register your plate) avoids €50–320 penalties plus rental admin fees; GPS routes you straight into the zone otherwise.

Pre-Departure To-Do

What to do when

Updated July 2026: deadlines separate tracking, refundable holds, and real booking windows so the list does not create false urgency a year out.

blocks.title: Track, do not panic-buy
blocks.note: Inventory opening is a search-alert trigger, not a cash-fare deadline.
items: Set fare alerts for the protected routing plus one acceptable fallback airport/routing.
Do not buy cash airfare just because seats opened; only grab award space or a fare already inside the trip budget with good flight times.
Track the Madeira-Sicily open-jaw chain; do not buy until the protected routing and total price both work.

blocks.title: Hold scarce refundable stays
blocks.note: This is about protecting scarce family inventory, not chasing prepaid discounts.
items: Hold refundable lodging across all bases; four-base trips need cancellation buffers more than early prepaid rates.
Prioritize AC, parking, and washer access over boutique charm.

blocks.title: Cars, ferries, and route anchors
blocks.note: Use cancellable/pay-later terms where possible, then re-shop after flights are purchased.
items: Reserve cancellable automatics, especially in Sicily where manual inventory is more common.
Check ZTL/parking exposure before finalizing Sicilian old-town stays.

blocks.title: Buy flights in the real window
blocks.note: For peak-summer Europe, this is the practical cash-buy window: Google Flights puts U.S.-Europe fares near 94 days out, while Going gives 2-8 months for international trips and says to shift earlier for peak periods.
items: Buy when the total family fare and schedule both work; waiting for a theoretical bottom is not worth bad layovers or split seats.

blocks.title: Timed tickets and tours
blocks.note: These are the tasks with real external release windows or limited capacity.
items: Madeira classified PR hikes require online payment/reservation before hiking; same-day works only if slots remain (IFCN).
Book Etna/boat/tour anchors 60-90 days out; keep one flexible day for wind, heat, or volcanic/weather disruption.
Reserve must-have restaurants 30-60 days out, not now.

blocks.title: Final checks
items: Passports: Schengen requires validity 3+ months after planned EU departure and issue within the last 10 years (EU); renew before winter if anyone is close.
ETIAS: no July 2026 action; the U.S. State Dept. says ETIAS is planned for late 2026, so apply only after the official system launches (State Dept.).
Insurance: compare family medical/trip coverage after the first meaningful deposit; waiver timing is policy-specific, so do not wait until final payment if coverage matters.
Re-check Madeira trail closures, Etna status, ferry/boat wind, and ZTL rules before travel.

Expedia 2026 Air Hacks found 180+ day bookings were the most expensive category in its data; Going puts international trips in a 2-8 month window, and Google Flights says U.S.-Europe trips cluster around 94 days out with risk rising inside 50 days. Track now, buy early only for award seats, unusually good protected routing, or a fare already inside budget.
